name: Finbar
long_description:
Finbar is high-quality financial data and intelligence, used by several of the world's largest hedge funds. It automates financial modelling, research, and data analysis so multi-million-dollar decisions can be made 100x faster.

Finbar maintains its own dataset of worldwide company filings, presentations, transcripts, and more, delivering clean data from these fundamental sources within minutes of release. This data is available via web, Excel add-in, API, and MCP. 

Our services include: company primers and prebuilt models; AI tools for analysts to create their own research; Excel tools to build financial models in minutes and update them in seconds; API streams to integrate our worldwide data into any programmatic or agentic system.
